clips.title: The story
paras: In Thelsamar, Vidra Hearthstove cooks local specialties at the Stoutlager Inn. She often relies on traveling adventurers to gather ingredients for her famous blood sausages.

Vidra Hearthstove cooks for locals and travelers at the Stoutlager Inn in Loch Modan. Sharing a surname with the innkeeper, she helps keep Thelsamar well provisioned. Her signature dish, Thelsamar blood sausages, calls for fresh game from the surrounding wilderness: boar entrails, spider ichor, and bear meat.
